 electrically and mechanically

items:

 valve must be zero from the two end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Attach a sling to the actuator (1) assembly.
Remove the stem clamp (2)
Remove the packing flange (3) and yoke clamp (4).
Lift the actuator assembly from the body (5) assembly and rem
Screw off nut (6) of bolt (7) which connected bonnet (8) with valve body.
Remove the bonnet from the body.
Remove the bonnet gasket (9) and upper spaces gasket (10).

Remove the packing (11) as follows:
 - Remove the packing flange and packing follower (12)
 - Using a packing tool, remove all packing.

Remove the spindle.
Lift the disk stack (14) assembly from the body.
Remove the seat ring (15) from the body.
Remove the flex. gaskets (16) from the seat ring.

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document
 outlines the maintenance procedures P1 of main steam stop valve, depend 
 on external or internal leakage.
This valve is used for feed the water to the drum and de-superheat the main 
 steam.
Technical specification
Item | High capacity feed water control valve | Low capacity feed water control valve | Main steam de super control valve
Kind of valve | Fouress CV | Fouress CV | Drag CV
Class | 1500 | 1500 | 1500
Size of valve (mm) | 150 | 80 | 40
Tag No. | LAB10AA004 | LAB10AA007 | LAE75AA003
Max pressure (bar) | 212 | 212 | 212
Max temperature (oC) | 225 | 225 | 225
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Hesham Abdel Malek, reviewed by maintenance manger eng. Sobhey Abdel Haleem, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Ghaffar Al-Arish 
 PS general manager.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC planning & financial 
predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area.
Wear 
 the safety and healthy equipment as: safety 
 helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs .... etc
Isolate the valve electrically and mechanically.
Drain the pipeline, which connected of valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning 
 fluid.
Suitable 
 lifting device
Lapping tools and grinding compound.
Work to be Carried Out
Before isolating the valve mechanically
Check any leakage from valve gland.
Check any external leakage.
Check any internal leakage.
Check any leakage from the valve bodies ( cracks or mechanical 
 wear ).
After isolating the valve 
 electrically and mechanically
Be sure the pressure inside the pipeline connected to the 
 valve must be zero from the two end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Disassembly 
 the valve
Attach a sling to the actuator (1) assembly.
Remove the stem clamp (2)
Remove the packing flange (3) and yoke clamp (4).
Lift the actuator assembly from the body (5) assembly and rem
Screw off nut (6) of bolt (7) which connected bonnet (8) with valve body.
Remove the bonnet from the body.
Remove the bonnet gasket (9) and upper spaces gasket (10).
Remove the packing (11) as follows:
 - Remove the packing flange and packing follower (12)
 - Using a packing tool, remove all packing.
 - Replace the suitable packing size on a part of shaft with the same diameter 
 of valve spindle (13).
Remove the spindle.
Lift the disk stack (14) assembly from the body.
Remove the seat ring (15) from the body.
Remove the flex. gaskets (16) from the seat ring.
Inspect and Repair of all 
 parts
Check the body from any cracks or wear by using penetration 
 fluids and repair it if needed.
Check the seat ring and regrind it if needed.
Check the spindle and repair it if needed or replace it.
Check the flex. gaskets and change it if needed.
Check the bushing (17) and repair it if needed or replace it.
Check the packing and change it if needed.
Check the packing follower, packing spacer, packing flange and 
 repair it if needed or replace it.
Assembly of the Valve
Clean every parts well before any assembly.
Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of disassembly
Open and close the valve and be sure that the valve operation is correct.
Trouble Shouting
Problem | Action
Stem packing leakage | Inspect the steam and replace the assembly if it is 
 damaged, also replace the packing
Excessive internal leakage | - Disassemble the valve, check for damage to the seat 
 ring/spindle and seals and replace as necessary
 - Seat grinding
Bonnet leakage | Check the parts and replace the damage parts
